name: Charlotte Bronte
original_name: シャーロット・ブロンテ
source:
Charlotte Bronte (or Charl, for her friends) is the daughter of a Marquess from the Duchy of Asimoff. She studied at the Sentinel Academy alongside Yuragi and Kano, where the three girls became inseparable until an incident suddenly sent the Bronte household in total chaos…

Charl has always been a history maniac, dreaming to travel the world as an archaeologist to unravel the mysteries of the world. Her composed personality tends to change into the one of a passionate fanatic whenever somebody talks about relics or ancient legends. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1268&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]Mangagamer[/url]]
